staticCandidates.repairReason: The central gray-green source patches remain in approximately the same area, but the candidate gives them crisply bounded angular slab shapes and an overlapping X-like arrangement with pronounced dark separations. The actual original supports soft damp green patches more clearly than discrete stacked slate. Reduce the hard geometric boundaries/relief and keep the broad damp source reading; retain the original muddy divisions and neighboring strips.

The upper-left green-gray source area and smaller lower patch are sharpened into distinct angular stone slabs with dark encircling divisions. Their positions are broadly retained, but this hard slate/raised-rock interpretation overstates the diffuse damp patches in the actual original. Flatten/soften those green accents while preserving the original muddy divisions and neighboring atlas fragments.

The broad left cool-gray and right mossy-earth distribution is retained, but the candidate introduces a branching network of crisp dark fracture lines through the pale central/lower slabs. These thin internal fractures are not established by the actual original soft mottled areas and give substantially stronger stone relief. Keep the broad original divisions, reducing unsupported fine fissures and hard slab edges; preserve neighboring fragments.

The original subdued green/brown mottling is converted into much more distinct bright yellow-green moss/leaf-like clumps, regularly separated by dark earth. The broad coverage is similar, but individual clumps become recognizable and higher contrast, shifting the source from soft damp accents toward new foliage. Restore softer muted green variation without discrete leaf-like motifs or stronger glow; keep the existing negative-space boundary.

The broad pale tapered source patch reads as a diffuse flat light area. The candidate retains the neural interpretation as a domed protruding stone with a dark boundary/shadow. Repair this semantic relief before selecting.

The original pale oval is a diffuse region. The candidate retains a strong surrounding arched rim and aperture-like shading from the neural baseline. Reduce relief/depth and retain the diffuse source interpretation.

newPanoramaDrafts.repairReason: Broad layout is faithful: apertures, ladders, hanging points, diagonal walkway and lower ledges remain in source positions; repeated contact shows inherited original discontinuities without new reflected geometry. At native BOX scale mean RGB changes from [40.11,26.34,17.15] to [53.00,33.72,21.62], and mean Rec.709 luma rises from28.60 to36.94 (+29%). Restore the original broad values/darkness while retaining finer material detail; mean luma is corroborating evidence, not a standalone acceptance threshold.

dynamicTimingUnit: eligible renderBattleStage invocation; pauses when stage render guard is false; no wall-clock FPS claim
nativeQueueContract: slots enqueue ascending at z=1; GPU executes z descending, each queue LIFO; therefore copying slots execute descending. Graphics.endFrame resets setMaskBit=false/drawPixels=ALWAYS at z=3 before stage z=1 copies in the normal frame path.
externalStateLimitations: scriptCopyVram, other TIM/effect uploads and GPU queue interleaving not enumerated per encounter
applyScreenDarkening uploads parameterized 64x16 words at [448,240] from the stage backup; native fallback must preserve those transitions
native startFrame uploads prior endFrame copy results; renderer frame/animation presentation and lifetime need independent integration validation
isolated frame hash dedup does not authorize shared ownership, static replacement, generation or final art acceptance
